ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-H in the area bounded
by:
West Devon Avenue; a line 198.30 feet west of and parailel to North
Hoyne Avenue; a line 125 feet south of and parallel to West Devon
Avenue; and a line 238.30 feet west of and parallel to North Hoyne

Avenue;

to those of a B2-1 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2125 West Devon Avenue
